common_patterns.name: Design by Contract
common_patterns.technique: Assertions and pre/postconditions
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Catches invalid state before it leaks across module boundaries.

common_patterns.name: Type-Driven Design
common_patterns.technique: Strong domain types and impossible-state encoding
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Makes illegal states unrepresentable at compile time where the stack allows it.

common_patterns.name: Property-Based Testing
common_patterns.technique: Generated counterexamples over invariant space
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Finds edge cases human examples usually miss.

common_patterns.name: Model-Based Testing
common_patterns.technique: Executable reference model for behavior
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Detects implementation drift against a simpler specification.

common_patterns.name: Mutation Testing
common_patterns.technique: Tests must fail when behavior is deliberately damaged
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents false confidence from weak assertions.

common_patterns.name: Static Analysis Gate
common_patterns.technique: Linters, type checks, SAST and schema checks in CI
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Moves defect discovery from runtime into coding time.

common_patterns.name: Exhaustive Case Analysis
common_patterns.technique: Closed enums, sealed types and total switches
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops unhandled states from silently reaching production.

common_patterns.name: Immutability by Default
common_patterns.technique: Immutable values except at explicit boundaries
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces hidden mutation, race conditions and spooky action at a distance.

common_patterns.name: Pure Core, Imperative Shell
common_patterns.technique: Pure decision logic wrapped by IO adapters
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Keeps business behavior deterministic and easy to test.

common_patterns.name: Boundary Validation
common_patterns.technique: Validate all external input at the edge
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents polluted data from entering trusted internals.

common_patterns.name: Schema and Contract Validation
common_patterns.technique: OpenAPI, JSON Schema, AsyncAPI or equivalent
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Turns interface agreements into machine-checkable facts.

common_patterns.name: Consumer-Driven Contract Tests
common_patterns.technique: Provider behavior checked against consumer expectations
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops backend/frontend and service-to-service drift.

common_patterns.name: Semantic Versioning
common_patterns.technique: Public behavior changes only through explicit version rules
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents accidental breaking changes.

common_patterns.name: Backward Compatibility Window
common_patterns.technique: Deprecated behavior remains available for a planned interval
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Lets clients migrate without emergency coordination.

common_patterns.name: Idempotency Key
common_patterns.technique: Repeatable commands use stable operation identity
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents duplicate writes after retry or network uncertainty.

common_patterns.name: Optimistic Concurrency Control
common_patterns.technique: Version or status guard on state transitions
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Blocks lost updates and read-then-save races.

common_patterns.name: Deterministic State Machine
common_patterns.technique: Explicit states and transition table
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents ambiguous lifecycle behavior.

common_patterns.name: Transactional Outbox
common_patterns.technique: Persist state change and event publication atomically
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Avoids split-brain between database and broker.

common_patterns.name: Saga with Compensating Actions
common_patterns.technique: Long workflow split into reversible steps
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Contains partial failure in distributed processes.

common_patterns.name: Circuit Breaker
common_patterns.technique: Stop calling unhealthy dependencies temporarily
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents cascading outages.

common_patterns.name: Bulkhead Isolation
common_patterns.technique: Separate resource pools for separate failure domains
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops one overloaded path from sinking the whole system.

common_patterns.name: Retry with Exponential Backoff and Jitter
common_patterns.technique: Bounded retry for transient faults
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces thundering herd and retry storms.

common_patterns.name: Rate Limiting and Backpressure
common_patterns.technique: Control inflow before queues become unbounded
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Protects latency, memory and external APIs.

common_patterns.name: Timeout Budgeting
common_patterns.technique: Every remote call has a bounded time contract
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Avoids stuck threads and zombie workflows.

common_patterns.name: Observability and Traceability
common_patterns.technique: Logs, metrics, spans and correlation IDs
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Turns suspicion into inspectable evidence.

common_patterns.name: Structured Error Taxonomy
common_patterns.technique: Errors include class, cause, retryability and safe action
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents ambiguous recovery behavior.

common_patterns.name: Audit Trail
common_patterns.technique: Security and business-critical decisions are recorded
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Makes accountability and rollback analysis possible.

common_patterns.name: Least Privilege
common_patterns.technique: Grant only the minimum required authority
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Limits blast radius after bugs or compromise.

common_patterns.name: Zero Trust Verification
common_patterns.technique: No caller, token or payload is trusted by default
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops confused-deputy and spoofing defects.

common_patterns.name: Secrets Isolation
common_patterns.technique: Secrets never enter source, logs or client bundles
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents credential leaks.

common_patterns.name: Input Canonicalization
common_patterns.technique: Normalize before validation, comparison or authorization
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents bypass through alternate representations.

common_patterns.name: Safe Output Encoding
common_patterns.technique: Encode per target context
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents injection through UI, SQL, shell, logs or URLs.

common_patterns.name: Accessibility by Default
common_patterns.technique: WCAG, keyboard flow and touch target checks
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents unusable interfaces from passing as complete.

common_patterns.name: Golden Master Regression
common_patterns.technique: Preserve known observable behavior during risky change
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Catches accidental regressions in legacy surfaces.

common_patterns.name: Snapshot with Semantic Assertions
common_patterns.technique: Snapshots are paired with behavior assertions
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents brittle visual/text snapshots from hiding real defects.

common_patterns.name: Test Data Builder
common_patterns.technique: Named fixtures built through domain factories
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces fragile test setup and accidental invalid data.

common_patterns.name: Reproducible Seed Injection
common_patterns.technique: Randomness and time are injectable in tests
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Removes flakes from nondeterministic logic.

common_patterns.name: Containerized Toolchain Contract
common_patterns.technique: Build/test commands run in pinned containers
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents PATH, JDK, Node and native binding drift.

common_patterns.name: In-Memory Test Datasource
common_patterns.technique: Tests isolate database state from local files
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Avoids stale file DB corruption and cross-run contamination.

common_patterns.name: Migration Serialization
common_patterns.technique: Schema changes pass through one ordered lane
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents competing migrations and Flyway collisions.

common_patterns.name: Migration Rollback Plan
common_patterns.technique: Every migration has a tested recovery story
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces irreversible production failures.

common_patterns.name: Feature Flag Isolation
common_patterns.technique: Incomplete work is hidden behind explicit capability switches
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Lets parallel branches land without exposing half-built behavior.

common_patterns.name: Canary Release
common_patterns.technique: Expose change to a small monitored population first
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Detects production-only failures before full rollout.

common_patterns.name: Fast Rollback
common_patterns.technique: Rollback is practiced and bounded by time
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Keeps recovery from becoming improvisation.

common_patterns.name: Small Vertical PR
common_patterns.technique: One coherent behavior slice per PR
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Shrinks review surface and conflict probability.

common_patterns.name: Merge Queue Gate
common_patterns.technique: Rebuild and retest on current main before merge
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops green-but-stale PRs from breaking main.

common_patterns.name: Single Writer Ownership
common_patterns.technique: Each shared surface has a declared owner
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents parallel agents from editing the same contract blindly.

common_patterns.name: CODEOWNERS and Review Routing
common_patterns.technique: Ownership is enforced by repository rules
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Ensures the right role sees the risky change.

common_patterns.name: Generated Artifact Authority
common_patterns.technique: Generated files are changed only through the generator
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents manual drift and regeneration conflicts.

common_patterns.name: Append-Only Extension Point
common_patterns.technique: Prefer new files/registrations over editing shared cores
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Reduces merge conflicts in parallel work.

common_patterns.name: No Shared Constants Drift
common_patterns.technique: Enums and constants have one owner and compatibility tests
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Stops semantic divergence behind identical names.

common_patterns.name: Route Ownership Registry
common_patterns.technique: Each endpoint has one owning controller or handler
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents duplicate-route runtime failures.

common_patterns.name: Endpoint Collision Scan
common_patterns.technique: CI checks that no two handlers claim the same method/path
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Catches Spring/FastAPI/Express route conflicts before boot.

common_patterns.name: Semantic Conflict Test
common_patterns.technique: After text merge, run affected contract and behavior tests
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Catches meaning conflicts that Git cannot see.

common_patterns.name: Conflict Forecast in PR
common_patterns.technique: PR declares touched paths, owners and integration points
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Lets reviewers spot collisions before code lands.

common_patterns.name: Conflict Resolution Evidence
common_patterns.technique: Manual conflict resolution must add or run targeted evidence
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents guessed merges from entering main.

common_patterns.name: No-Op Supersession
common_patterns.technique: Superseded PRs are converted to tested no-op merges or closed
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Clears stale work without reintroducing old code.

common_patterns.name: Stale Claim Self-Healing
common_patterns.technique: Stuck automation claims are released with evidence
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Keeps autonomous queues moving.

common_patterns.name: CI Status Reconciliation
common_patterns.technique: System reconciles GitHub state with internal task state
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents already-merged work from staying blocked.

common_patterns.name: RAG Source-Grounded Retrieval
common_patterns.technique: Agents cite exact source chunks before applying doctrine
common_patterns.why_defect_preventing: Prevents philosophical slogans from becoming hallucinated rules.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Single owner for every mutable surface
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Every shared file, contract, enum, migration lane and generated artifact has one owner.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Contract before implementation
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: API, event, schema and RAG contracts are reviewed before parallel implementation starts.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Generated files are read-only
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Change the generator or source data, then regenerate.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Append-only by default
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Prefer new extension files or registry rows over edits to shared central files.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Small vertical PRs
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: One PR covers one behavior slice, not feature plus refactor plus formatting.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Merge queue over direct merge
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Every PR is rebuilt on current main before landing.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Serialized migrations
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Database migrations, shared enums and global schemas pass through a single ordered lane.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Refactor freeze lane
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Broad moves, renames and formatting run in their own window.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Conflict forecast
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Task and PR describe touched paths, owners, contracts and expected integration points.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Semantic conflict checks
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: After merge, affected contract, schema and smoke tests must run.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Feature flag isolation
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Incomplete parallel work cannot affect shared runtime without a flag.

conflict_prevention_rules.name: Evidence after conflict resolution
conflict_prevention_rules.requirement: Manual conflict fixes require targeted tests or contract checks.

philosophers.role_application: Код — это язык команды, а не просто инструкция машине. Агент проверяет, что код читается одинаково всеми участниками системы: имена функций, переменных и модулей передают намерение, а не только механику
philosophers.focus: Качество кода, стандарты написания, обязательный Code Review всех PR, архитектурные паттерны на уровне реализации, онбординг новых агентов в кодовую базу
